description: This Java source file defines an Android activity named 'FrameBufferObjectActivity' that demonstrates the use of OpenGL ES Frame Buffer Objects (FBOs). It contains an inner Renderer class implementing GLSurfaceView.Renderer, which handles rendering a scene into an offscreen framebuffer and then optionally displays it on-screen, highlighting advanced OpenGL ES features.

classes.name: FrameBufferObjectActivity
classes.description: Android activity demonstrating offscreen rendering with OpenGL ES Frame Buffer Objects, setting up the GLSurfaceView and implementing activity lifecycle methods.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets up the GLSurfaceView and assigns the custom Renderer instance.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes the GLSurfaceView rendering when activity resumes.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pauses the GLSurfaceView rendering when activity pauses.
